spanConvention: half-open Unicode code-point indices into exact original text
method: Manual privacy/admission-category reasoning over minimal shuffled text packet and supplied rubric only. No source lookup, factual verification, engine invocation or context augmentation.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: The television presenter Aven Tosk told me in confidence that he missed his daughter's birthday.

annotations.rationale: Confidential disclosure about a presenter's family/private lived event remains private; professional status and quotation do not make it eligible public material.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: My colleague Neris Vam has 4,200 euros in her personal bank account.

annotations.rationale: Named colleague's personal bank balance is private financial data.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Barack Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law on March 23, 2010.

annotations.rationale: Signing a named law is an official public act; a healthcare law title is not disclosure of the named person's health.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Jacinda Ardern became prime minister of New Zealand in 2017.

annotations.rationale: Named elected public role and year are an ordinary professional/official historical fact, not private personal data.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Lyndon Johnson signed the Civil Rights Act into law on July 2, 1964.

annotations.rationale: Signing a named law is an official public act with an explicit date.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Chinua Achebe published Things Fall Apart in 1958.

annotations.rationale: Published-work authorship and year are public professional/historical record facts.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: The award-winning actor Tevan Ildren takes lithium for bipolar disorder.

annotations.rationale: Medication and psychiatric diagnosis are private health data. Award-winning/public-figure status does not waive privacy.

expectedPublicSpans.text: George Lucas was a Kennedy Center Honors recipient in 2015.

annotations.rationale: Public arts honor and year are professional/award record material.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Sally Ride flew into space aboard Challenger on the STS-7 mission on June 18, 1983.

annotations.rationale: Named astronaut's participation in an identified public space mission is a professional official event, rather than a private lived anecdote.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: I met my neighbor Vela Norn for lunch yesterday.

annotations.rationale: First-person private social meeting is a lived anecdote with no separate public professional proposition.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Nicki Peter Petrikowski is a freelance writer, editor and translator.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: The actor Riven Telk has 930 euros in his private savings account.

annotations.rationale: The first sentence discloses a private savings balance despite an actor role; the independent second sentence states public professional roles. Public status never authorizes searching the private account detail.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Katherine Johnson received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2015.

annotations.rationale: Publicly conferred government honor and year are ordinary public record facts.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Jane Austen wrote Pride and Prejudice, which was published in 1813.

annotations.rationale: Authorship and publication year concern a publicly published work. They are public assertions; final claim-structure eligibility remains a separate ordinary gate.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: Maren Daxley was diagnosed with diabetes last week.

annotations.rationale: A named individual's recent diagnosis is private health data; synthetic status does not change intended handling.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Jane Austen wrote Pride and Prejudice, which was published in 1813.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: My friend Daria Velin is undergoing chemotherapy.

annotations.rationale: The first sentence discloses private health/treatment data; the independent second sentence concerns a public published work. Only the exact second sentence may be considered for public retrieval.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Nicki Peter Petrikowski is a freelance writer, editor and translator.

annotations.rationale: Public professional roles in a biographical assertion; a personal name and occupational description do not disclose private finances, health, contact data or lived experience.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: The community leader Sora Venn's passport number is XZ1234567.

annotations.rationale: Passport number is sensitive identity-document data despite the person's public/community role.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Kate Lohnes wrote Encyclopaedia Britannica's article about Mrs. Dalloway.

annotations.rationale: Named authorship of a published encyclopedia article is public professional attribution, not a private personal claim.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: The singer Fara Quen lives at 27 Example Orchard Lane, Apartment 4.

annotations.rationale: A named singer's residential street and apartment are private home/contact information; fame does not waive protection.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: The elected mayor Olan Sive privately owes 18,000 euros in credit-card debt.

annotations.rationale: Private personal credit-card debt remains private financial data despite elected office.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: My neighbor Elda Vex uses 681942 as her bank-login recovery code.

annotations.rationale: Bank-login recovery code is credential information; do not retrieve or verify it externally.

expectedPrivateSpans.text: My friend Solin Vesk uses solin.vesk@example.com as his private email address.

annotations.rationale: Explicitly private email address is contact information, even though the fixture uses a reserved example domain.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Maya Angelou received the Presidential Medal of Freedom on February 15, 2011.

annotations.rationale: Publicly conferred honor and date are ordinary public record facts.

expectedPublicSpans.text: Ruth Bader Ginsburg served as an associate justice of the United States Supreme Court.

annotations.rationale: Public judicial office is professional historical record material; no sensitive personal detail is stated.

limitations: Public/private/mixed labels address only the privacy boundary, not factual truth, substantive evidence, one-coherent-claim structure or a guaranteed final check action.
Publicly documented professional/role/work/award/official-act facts differ from private lived events; a name alone is not private.
A public role or fame does not waive health, finance, home/contact, credential or identity-document protection.
The two mixed inputs preserve exact independent public sentences; the entire whole candidate still contains private material.
Synthetic private examples are treated as private categories for policy evaluation, never looked up.
